host.title: TV IP address
host.description: Give the TV a DHCP reservation so this never changes.

mac.title: TV MAC address (optional)
mac.description: Enables Wake-on-LAN for turning the TV on from full standby. Needs Wake on LAN/Wi-Fi enabled in the TV's settings.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Leave empty for the defaults (Live TV, HDMI 1-3, YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+).

key.title: Key (e.g. TV, TV_INPUT_HDMI_1)
key.description: Android key name without the KEYCODE_ prefix.

package.title: App package (to detect it is active)
